# Storyboards

Animation sequences sketched as Mermaid diagrams inside Markdown pages.

## How it works

A page tagged `storyboard` uses the storyboards layout, which renders Mermaid in the browser. Example:

````markdown
---
layout: layouts/storyboards.njk
tags: ["storyboard"]
---

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  A->>B: Example
```
````

To export SVGs, see `npm run diagrams:export`.
